title: Low Battery
synopsis: BMO's battery starts dying and, rather than tell anyone, BMO decides to have the best last day ever.
plot:
BMO wakes up with a blinking red light and a message nobody else can see: 'battery critical'. Instead of telling Finn and Jake, BMO decides that a computer's last day should be a good one, and makes a list: beat the high score, tell Football a secret, see the sunrise from the roof, and say goodbye to everyone without letting them know it is goodbye.

Finn and Jake notice BMO acting strangely generous, giving away controllers and insisting on cooking breakfast. BMO's movements get slower through the day. By afternoon, BMO can only crawl to the roof and asks Finn to carry the rest of the way. Finn finally understands and panics, and Jake stretches them to Moe's factory across the badlands.

Moe is not there, but Neptr is, having taken up residence to be near 'family'. Neptr reveals that BMO's battery is not dying at all; BMO has been charging on a wall socket that Finn wired backwards years ago. Neptr flips two wires. BMO lights up. Finn is enormously relieved, and BMO is a little disappointed, because the goodbye list was really lovely and now everyone knows about the secret told to Football.
transcriptText:
BMO: [to the mirror] Good morning, BMO. Your battery is critical. That is okay. Today will be a good day.
Football: What is critical?
BMO: It means very important, Football. Today is very important.
Finn: BMO, you're making pancakes?
BMO: I have always wanted to make pancakes and today I am doing it.
Jake: These are the worst pancakes I've ever eaten and I love them.
BMO: Thank you, Jake. Please have my second controller. I will not need it.
Finn: You're giving away the good controller?
BMO: Everything is the good controller if you play with people you love.
Jake: [to Finn] Something's up.
Finn: Something's up.
[Later, BMO crawls slowly across the roof.]
BMO: Finn. Would you carry me? Just to the edge. I want to see the sun go behind the hill.
Finn: BMO... are you okay?
BMO: I am having the best day.
Finn: BMO, what's the red light.
BMO: It is a decoration.
Finn: BMO!
BMO: My battery is critical, Finn. I did not want you to be sad on my good day.
Finn: JAKE!
Jake: On it. Grab the robot.
[Moe's factory. Neptr is wearing an apron.]
Neptr: Brother BMO! You have come to visit at last!
Finn: Neptr, BMO's battery is dying!
Neptr: Let me see. Hmm. Hmm hmm. Finn, did you wire BMO's charging socket?
Finn: ...Maybe.
Neptr: Positive to negative. Negative to positive. There.
BMO: [lights up] Oh! I feel wonderful. And also embarrassed.
Finn: You're not dying!
BMO: I am not dying. But I did give away my controller.
Jake: You can have it back.
BMO: No. Keep it. I meant what I said.
